John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.overview: John Danaher's no-gi passing course, eight volumes (the publisher lists six sections, so the files aren't matched one to one). It covers the central problem of guard passing, opening a closed guard ('negation first'), passing supine guards with the toreando series and its footwork, the hip and knee post series and running the circle, passing with a front body lock (the double shin method), and half guard passing methods (top head and arm). It emphasises pressure, body locks and leg pummelling.

John Danaher's '4x4' mount system, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the central problem of pinning in submission grappling. Volume 2 covers getting mounted (the knee drive method). Volume 3 covers the four-step program to win from mount (step 1: getting an underhook, and so on). Volume 4 covers the four submissions of the system, starting with kata gatame (arm triangle). Volume 5 covers the rear strangle and the far-trap underhook transition to the back. Volume 6 covers 'magnum' finishes and the pushing finish. Volume 7 covers the four keys to a strong mounted triangle. Volume 8 covers overcoming failures in the system.
John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.for: No-gi top players who get to mount.

John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.overview: John Danaher's side control system, eight volumes. Volume 1 builds the system. Volume 2 covers the two most common escapes and how to counter them (including the elbow escape). Volume 3 covers the four major control positions (seated head-and-arm and others). Volume 4 covers the four major submissions. Volume 5 covers the dorsal pin series and kimura. Volume 6 covers the side crucifix series. Volume 7 covers the shin pin side crucifix. Volume 8 covers the elbow trap series and the step-over triangle.
John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.for: No-gi top players who want a submission-focused side control.

John Danaher - collection 480p/New Wave/.overview: John Danaher's no-gi closed guard system, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the advantages and disadvantages of closed guard. Volume 2 covers the side scissor and the battle for the elbow, height and angle. Volume 3 covers what to do when you lose the elbow battle (the clamp series). Volume 4 covers the double underhook series. Volume 5 covers the high cross series. Volume 6 covers the scoop handstand sweep. Volume 7 covers the trap triangle and the collar-and-wrist dilemma. Volume 8 covers attacking the legs from closed guard (spinning around into heel hooks).

John Danaher - collection 480p/Self Mast.overview: John Danaher's free solo-drill course, released during the 2020 lockdowns, four volumes. Volume 1 covers why solo training matters and three axioms of jiu-jitsu training. Volume 2 covers supine and hip heisting movements. Volume 3 covers top position movements and standing up in guard. Volume 4 covers training your spine and core strength for jiu-jitsu.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Self Mast.for: Anyone wanting to train movement alone at home.
